title: Humans Race Horses Every Year In Wales
description:
The Man versus Horse Marathon is an annual race in Llanwrtyd Wells, Wales, where runners compete against riders on horseback over road, trail and mountain terrain. It began in 1980 when a pub landlord, Gordon Green, overheard two men arguing over whether a man could match a horse over a long distance and decided to test it in public. In 2004, in the 25th race, Huw Lobb won in 2 hours 5 minutes 19 seconds, the first time a runner on foot won, claiming a prize fund that had grown by 1,000 pounds each year to 25,000 pounds. That year had the most competitors ever: 500 runners and 40 horses.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Man versus Horse Marathon'.

Who would win, you or a horse? Tell us in the comments.
